verdict.rationale: Drive offers event primitives: API push notifications fire when a watched resource changes, there is a changes resource, and docs show example automations such as creating Drive files from Google Form submissions. The user has to build the rule logic and action handlers in their own code; the evidence shows no built-in rule builder. Missing for 10: native user-definable rule/trigger configuration, documented action execution tied to events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
